# dsh-workspace-folders
Native-feeling folder organization for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** web sidebar.

DSH's left sidebar lists every Workspace as a flat section. This plugin adds the missing
organizatio

nal layer — **user-created folders for Workspaces**, **nested Session folders inside
each Workspace*

*, and **per-row icons** — while keeping the shipped sidebar interactions
(drag, rename, pin, archiv
e, search, view options) intact.

The folder layer is **display-only**: it never renames a Workspace or a Session, never moves a
Sessi

on between Workspaces, and never touches a directory on disk. It only rearranges the
sidebar. Sessio
n folders are durable (`dsh-session-keeper`'s host-side storage).
## Features
### Workspace folders (display-only)

- Create, rename, delete, collapse and re-order folders from the sidebar itself.
- File a Workspace

by dragging its row anywhere onto a folder block (the header
row or its expanded body), or through t

he row's `… → Move to folder…` menu.
- Clean up a Workspace in one step with `… → Archive all sessio

ns…`: it archives
every idle Session there (running Sessions are listed as skipped, so nothing
in fl

ight is stopped) and never touches the Session you have open.
- Drop a folder on the middle of anoth

er folder to nest it; drop it on the top/bottom edge to
re-order siblings. Drag a Workspace onto **U

nfiled** to take it out of a folder.
- Dropping a Workspace inside the folder it already belongs to

re-orders it there; anywhere
else files it into that folder.
- Deleting a folder only deletes the gr

ouping: subfolders move up, member Workspaces return to
**Unfiled**. No Workspace, Session or file i

s removed.
- With no folders, the list renders exactly like the shipped browser.
### Session folders (per Workspace, durable)

Every Workspace keeps its own nested category tree: drag Sessions in, create a Session inside a
cate

gory, collapse/rename, pin, archive with the three-state filter, and a recoverable delete bin.
Data
lives in the Host storage domain (survives reloads, cache clears and restarts).
### Icons

- Every Workspace row shows a quiet default **dot**; clicking it opens the icon picker.
- 40 icons f

rom the host's own icon set plus 48 common emoji; "Reset to default" clears the icon.
- Display fold

ers can carry their own icon as well.
- No new dependency, no network request, no image decoding. Th

e catalog renders only while the
picker is open; an idle sidebar costs one map lookup per row.
### Kept from the shipped browser

Search, grouping modes (Workspace / Workspace tree / flat), manual and recency ordering, pinned
Sess
ions, archive filtering, Workspace and Session row menus.
## Requirements

- DSH **>= 0.2.1-rc.1 < 0.3.0** (built and tested on 0.2.1-rc.5, desktop and web profile).
- Node.js
>= 24.9 is only needed to build from source; the published bundle ships prebuilt `lib/`.
## Install
From npm (once published):

From GitHub:

Then refresh the web UI (or restart DSH Desktop). The plugin appears as **dsh-workspace-folders**
in
the plugin manager; disable or remove it to restore the shipped browser.
## How to use
| Action | How |
| New top-level folder | View-options menu (sliders icon) → **New folder**, or the **+ New folder**

row at the end of the list |
| New subfolder | Folder row `…` → **New subfolder** |
| Rename | Doubl

e-click the folder name, or `…` → **Rename** |
| File a Workspace | Drag the Workspace row onto a fo

lder; or Workspace `…` → **Move to folder…** |
| Unfile | Drag the Workspace onto **Unfiled**; or `…

` → **Move to folder… → Unfiled** |
| Nest / re-order folders | Drag a folder to another folder's mi

ddle (nest) or top/bottom edge (re-order); or `…` → **Move to…** |
| Collapse / expand | Click the f

older row (collapsed shows the Workspace count) |
| Delete a folder | Folder `…` → **Delete folder**

(grouping only) |
| Set an icon | Click the row's leading dot/icon, or `…` → **Set icon…** |

Session folders keep the interactions from `dsh-session-keeper`: drag a Session onto a category,
`…
→ Move to category…`, create a Session inside a category, pin/archive/delete with undo.
## Data and privacy
| Data | Location |
| Workspace folders, folder assignments, expansion, icons (this plugin's display layer) | Browser `l

ocalStorage` under `dsh.session-categories.view.v2` |
| Session folders / assignments / recycle bin
| DSH Host storage domain `session_categories` (`<DSH_HOME>/storages/`) |

Nothing is uploaded anywhere. The display layer is intentionally browser-local: clearing the
site's
storage resets the Workspace folder layout (Session folders are unaffected).
## Compatibility

- The plugin **replaces** the sidebar's `sidebar.workspaces` region, so it cannot run together
with

another plugin that replaces the same region (e.g. `dsh-better-workspace`,
`dsh-workspace-categories

`). Remove one of them.
- With `dsh-claude-style` installed, its sidebar patches fight the replaceme

nt browser. Set these
in that plugin's config for the best result:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Other sidebar plugins that only decorate rows through slots, and themes that only style the
frame,

r plugins that only decorate rows through slots, and themes that only style the
frame, keep working.
## Build from source
[代码示例省略，未执行]

`lib/` is committed so consumers never need a build step. The Host half is prebuilt Node ESM;
`tsdow
n.host.config.ts` rebuilds it when the Host source changes.
## Known limitations

- Workspace folders only appear in the grouped views (**By Workspace** / **Workspace tree**);
the fl

at list and search results stay flat.
- The display folder layer (and icons) are browser-local, not

Host-persisted.
- Preview DSH releases do not promise plugin API stability; upgrade the plugin toget

d.
- Preview DSH releases do not promise plugin API stability; upgrade the plugin together with DSH.
